desc: Parse input, group items by vitamin (1,2,3) into three lists of (A, C).
Design check(T): per-vitamin min calories to reach T via knapsack; feasible iff sum <= X.
Optimization: compute each vitamin's DP frontier once (not per check), answer queries via searchsorted on monotone dp.
Binary search over T in [0, min(total A per vitamin)]; answer 0 if any vitamin group empty.
Implement complete program with numpy int64 DP, -inf sentinel (-(1<<60)), np.maximum.accumulate, searchsorted-based feasibility, and main() reading stdin / writing stdout.
